added: Added native MiniMax H3 VAE decode controls with Auto and Manual tiling, curated 256/320/384/512 tile-size presets, 64/96/128 overlap presets, adaptive tile batching, OOM backoff, and live decode progress.
Added low-RAM Lightning storage safeguards, swap-aware host-memory pressure telemetry, and recovery for broken text-encoder cache links without taking model residency away from ComfyUI DynamicVRAM.
Added exact H3 Studio PNG metadata restoration so generated images reopen with the generation state and seed that actually produced them.
fixed: Fixed promoted decode controls on the outer sampling subgraph so stale serialized values such as seed 42 cannot be interpreted as the tiling mode.
Fixed H3 Studio seed restoration from workflow metadata and prompt metadata instead of falling back to stale 0/1/42 values.
Quarantined the legacy H3 Studio Hub frontend without disabling its backend node registrations, preventing browser resource exhaustion while preserving required H3 nodes.
Reduced unnecessary decoded-frame cloning and kept native H3 VAE state fully restored after every decode.
changed: Kept H3's proven native 256/64 decode geometry as the Auto compatibility default while allowing bounded manual tuning for high-resolution testing.
Kept the validated FL2VA/REF2VA, Base Quality, LightX v0.1, Mamad8 PDD, preview, save, and workflow paths intact while hardening repeated L4 runs.
